title: Cohesity host link sync (sample)
description: Joins the Cohesity bridge metric to Dynatrace HOST serials and rewrites the host-link OpenPipeline inlineLookup tables. Sample asset - see dynatrace/sync-host-link-task.js for prerequisites and the actor scopes it needs.

sync_host_link_tables.name: sync_host_link_tables
sync_host_link_tables.description: Read the bridge metric and HOST serials from Grail, normalise both to canonical BIOS UUIDs, and write the two lookup tables.
